we have introduced a massive collection of NLP tasks, studied the effect of multi-tasks scaling, and proposed a model, ExT5, that achieves state-of-the-art performance across a diverse range of NLP tasks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the scaling of multi-task pre-trained models can be as important as scaling up the size of the pre-trained model itself.
scaling up the number tasks during pre-training has the potential of improving performance on a variety of tasks.
scaling up the number and diversity of tasks during pretraining can be beneficial for transfer learning, even when tasks are not hand-curated for a particular domain.
